1	[workspace]
2	resolver = "2"
3	members = [
4		"crates/agentmux",
5		"crates/agentmux-mcp",
6		"crates/agentmux-cli",
7	]
8	default-members = [
9		"crates/agentmux-cli",
10	]
11	
12	[workspace.package]
13	version = "0.1.0"
14	edition = "2024"
15	authors = ["romnn <contact@romnn.com>"]
16	description = "agentmux delegates a question to another vendor's coding agent and captures the whole transcript"
17	license-file = "LICENSE"
18	readme = "README.md"
19	homepage = "https://github.com/romnn/agentmux"
20	repository = "https://github.com/romnn/agentmux"
21	
22	[workspace.lints.rust]
23	warnings = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
24	unsafe_code = "deny"
25	unused_must_use = "deny"
26	missing_docs = "warn"
27	
28	[workspace.lints.clippy]
29	all = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }
30	pedantic = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }
31	unwrap_used      = "deny"
32	expect_used      = "deny"
33	panic            = "deny"
34	unreachable      = "deny"
35	unimplemented    = "deny"
36	todo             = "deny"
37	indexing_slicing = "deny"
38	missing_errors_doc = "warn"
39	await_holding_lock = "deny"
40	# Every `#[allow(...)]` must carry a `reason = "..."` justifying the escape hatch.
41	allow_attributes_without_reason = "deny"
42	
43	# Allowed
44	map_unwrap_or = "allow"
45	assigning_clones = "allow"
46	struct_excessive_bools = "allow"
47	
48	[workspace.metadata.cargo-fc]
49	install_missing_targets = true
50	dedupe = true
51	aggregate_targets = false
52	targets = [
53		"x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
54		"x86_64-pc-windows-gnu",
55		"aarch64-apple-darwin",
56	]
57	
58	[workspace.metadata.cargo-fc.subcommands.lint]
59	dedupe = true
60	
61	[workspace.metadata.cargo-fc.subcommands.udeps]
62	maximal_features = true
63	
64	[profile.release]
65	opt-level = 3
66	lto = true
67	codegen-units = 1
68	strip = "symbols"
69	
70	[workspace.dependencies]
71	color-eyre = "0"
72	thiserror = "2"
73	# Every multi-line string literal in this workspace is an `indoc!`, including the
74	# prompt scaffolding handed to a delegate CLI, where leading indentation would leak
75	# into the prompt text.
76	indoc = "2"
77	
78	# tracing
79	tracing = "0"
80	tracing-subscriber = { version = "0", features = ["env-filter"] }
81	
82	# serde
83	serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
84	serde_json = "1"
85	# `schemars` derives the JSON Schema for every MCP tool's input; `rmcp`'s `schemars`
86	# feature must stay on the same major.
87	schemars = "1"
88	# `clock` is what provides `Utc::now`; without it every timestamp would have to be
89	# injected, and run ids are minted from the wall clock.
90	chrono = { version = "0.4", default-features = false, features = ["std", "clock", "serde"] }
91	
92	# async runtime
93	tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
94	
95	# Model Context Protocol server SDK: `transport-io` is the stdio transport both
96	# Claude Code and Codex speak, `macros` provides `#[tool]`/`#[tool_router]`, and
97	# `schemars` makes tool arguments derive their schema instead of hand-writing it.
98	rmcp = { version = "3.2.0", features = ["server", "macros", "schemars", "transport-io"] }
99	
100	# cli
101	# `env` lets AGENTMUX_STATE_DIR select the run store without a flag, which is how an
102	# MCP host configures it.
103	clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive", "env"] }
104	
105	# Run identifiers are opaque and collision-free across concurrent delegations.
106	uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4"] }
107	# Renders the exact argv of a spawned delegate back into a copy-pasteable shell
108	# command for transcripts and error messages. Never used to *build* argv.
109	shell-words = "1"
110	directories = "6"
111	
112	# Unix process-group and signal handling: a delegate CLI spawns its own children, so
113	# a cancelled run must signal the whole group rather than the direct child. Pin the
114	# minor — `nix` makes breaking changes within 0.x.
115	# Features are chosen per crate.
116	nix = "0.31.3"
117	
118	# testing
119	googletest = "0"
120	tempfile = "3"

file.content:
[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
	"crates/agentmux",
	"crates/agentmux-mcp",
	"crates/agentmux-cli",
]
default-members = [
	"crates/agentmux-cli",
]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
authors = ["romnn <contact@romnn.com>"]
description = "agentmux delegates a question to another vendor's coding agent and captures the whole transcript"
license-file = "LICENSE"
readme = "README.md"
homepage = "https://github.com/romnn/agentmux"
repository = "https://github.com/romnn/agentmux"

[workspace.lints.rust]
warnings = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
unsafe_code = "deny"
unused_must_use = "deny"
missing_docs = "warn"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
all = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }
pedantic = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }
unwrap_used      = "deny"
expect_used      = "deny"
panic            = "deny"
unreachable      = "deny"
unimplemented    = "deny"
todo             = "deny"
indexing_slicing = "deny"
missing_errors_doc = "warn"
await_holding_lock = "deny"
# Every `#[allow(...)]` must carry a `reason = "..."` justifying the escape hatch.
allow_attributes_without_reason = "deny"

# Allowed
map_unwrap_or = "allow"
assigning_clones = "allow"
struct_excessive_bools = "allow"

[workspace.metadata.cargo-fc]
install_missing_targets = true
dedupe = true
aggregate_targets = false
targets = [
	"x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
	"x86_64-pc-windows-gnu",
	"aarch64-apple-darwin",
]

[workspace.metadata.cargo-fc.subcommands.lint]
dedupe = true

[workspace.metadata.cargo-fc.subcommands.udeps]
maximal_features = true

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
strip = "symbols"

[workspace.dependencies]
color-eyre = "0"
thiserror = "2"
# Every multi-line string literal in this workspace is an `indoc!`, including the
# prompt scaffolding handed to a delegate CLI, where leading indentation would leak
# into the prompt text.
indoc = "2"

# tracing
tracing = "0"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0", features = ["env-filter"] }

# serde
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
# `schemars` derives the JSON Schema for every MCP tool's input; `rmcp`'s `schemars`
# feature must stay on the same major.
schemars = "1"
# `clock` is what provides `Utc::now`; without it every timestamp would have to be
# injected, and run ids are minted from the wall clock.
chrono = { version = "0.4", default-features = false, features = ["std", "clock", "serde"] }

# async runtime
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }

# Model Context Protocol server SDK: `transport-io` is the stdio transport both
# Claude Code and Codex speak, `macros` provides `#[tool]`/`#[tool_router]`, and
# `schemars` makes tool arguments derive their schema instead of hand-writing it.
rmcp = { version = "3.2.0", features = ["server", "macros", "schemars", "transport-io"] }

# cli
# `env` lets AGENTMUX_STATE_DIR select the run store without a flag, which is how an
# MCP host configures it.
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive", "env"] }

# Run identifiers are opaque and collision-free across concurrent delegations.
uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4"] }
# Renders the exact argv of a spawned delegate back into a copy-pasteable shell
# command for transcripts and error messages. Never used to *build* argv.
shell-words = "1"
directories = "6"

# Unix process-group and signal handling: a delegate CLI spawns its own children, so
# a cancelled run must signal the whole group rather than the direct child. Pin the
# minor — `nix` makes breaking changes within 0.x.
# Features are chosen per crate.
nix = "0.31.3"

# testing
googletest = "0"
tempfile = "3"
